xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4478: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 7): controller handoff and reclaim

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 7): controller handoff and reclaim
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 22 files across the contracts package, the dashboard server, the dashboard frontend, one e2e spec and two doc files. The slice is one vertical feature the issue scopes as slice 7: host enforcement is meaningless without a way for a viewer-controller to send commands, and the viewer controls are unsafe without host enforcement. Every module ships with its own test file. Slices 2-5 shipped with the same shape.

narratives.Problem: The share service tracks a controller (slice 1) but nothing on the host or viewer uses it: ShareCommand lacks set-controller, ShareManager accepts every data-owner command whoever the room says controls, PeerHub reads only hello and submit on control, presence copies the share service's controller verbatim, and a viewer cannot tell whether it is the controller. The user docs say handoff comes in a later release.
narratives.Proposal: Add set-controller to ShareCommand and four control payloads (identity, command, controller-send, command-ack). A pure controller module holds the host's own appointment (effective controller = appointed viewer once the snapshot confirms it, else the data owner) and one gate function used by ShareManager for the data owner and by PeerHub for viewer-controllers. While a viewer controls, the owner's commands and prompts answer 409 not_controller except reclaim; End share is never gated. The viewer learns its id from identity, shows a You have control panel with the lobby roster, a controller-mode suggestion list and Send prompt, and every command waits for an ack with a 10 s timeout. The share dialog gets Hand control and Reclaim control. A three-dashboard Playwright spec proves A hands to B, B admits C, A reclaims; unit tests prove non-controller commands are rejected.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Un-revoke or End share by a viewer-controller; widening presence with the block list or connected flags
- Any change under services/share/ (Worker, reducer, protocol)
- New HTTP routes or no-loss-matrix.ts rows
- Restoring a viewer-controller after a host dashboard restart (slice 8, PAN-4479); a fresh hub starts with the data owner as controller
- Automatic reclaim when the controller goes offline
- Rate limiting a viewer-controller's commands
- Showing queued items (beyond the count) to a viewer-controller
- Handing control to a lobby participant or to a participant the host never admitted
- Persisting the controller appointment on the host's disk
- Changing JoinView or the viewer dashboard server share-join.ts
- Terminal channel (slice 6), pan share/pan join CLI (slice 9), hosted web join (slice 10)

autoDecisions.summary: While a viewer controls, the data owner's share commands and prompt sends answer 409 not_controller; reclaim and End share are always allowed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent PRD Host Role & Handoff: the host accepts control commands only from the current controller and exactly one controller exists; reclaim is one click, so the owner is never locked out.

autoDecisions.summary: The host enforces only a controller it appointed itself: effective controller = appointed viewer when the snapshot confirms it, else the data owner.
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent NFR-4 and D-R3-3: the share service must never be the sole authority; mirrors slice 3's host-admitted set, which a snapshot can shrink but never grow.

autoDecisions.summary: The viewer learns its own GitHub id from a new host control payload identity { githubId }, not from JoinView.
autoDecisions.rationale: Host-authoritative, needs no viewer-server change, and works when account.json has githubId null; avoids another conflict with PAN-4479 in share-join.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: The data owner's commands keep slice-2 target semantics (the share service validates); only set-controller targets and viewer-controller commands are validated on the host.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps slice-2 behavior and tests intact while remote viewer commands get host-side validation and an immediate ack.

autoDecisions.summary: A viewer-controller cannot un-revoke or end the share.
autoDecisions.rationale: Presence never carries the block list (slice 3 D-17/D-18); the owner reclaims in one click to do either.

autoDecisions.summary: A handoff target must be admitted and host-admitted but need not be connected; a disconnected controller keeps control.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the share service reducer (room-state.ts) and viewers cannot see connected flags.

autoDecisions.summary: Presence carries the host's effective controller and refreshes at once on reclaim; a handoff to a viewer shows when the snapshot confirms it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids a flash of the data owner between two viewer-controllers while keeping reclaim instant.

autoDecisions.summary: Viewer-controller prompts go through the slice-5 sendFromController queue door credited to the viewer, acked accepted with the queue position.
autoDecisions.rationale: One FIFO queue and one attribution path for every controller send (parent FR-14).

autoDecisions.summary: A viewer command with no ack fails after 10 s (COMMAND_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS) with 'The host did not answer.'
autoDecisions.rationale: An older host ignores the new payloads (NFR-2), so the viewer needs a bounded wait; tests use fake timers.

autoDecisions.summary: The end-to-end proof runs three isolated dashboards (owner, alice, bob).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance chain needs three identities: A hands to B, B admits C, A reclaims.

items.title: Add set-controller, controller commands, acks and identity to the sharing contracts

expected_outputs: grep finds no import line in sharing.ts

narrative.Action: Edit packages/contracts/src/sharing.ts exactly as PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4478.md section 'Wire format changes': widen ShareCommand (line 99) with 'set-controller'; add SharedControllerCommand (= Exclude<ShareCommand, unrevoke>) and SharedCommandRefusal (8 reasons); add optional ShareView.controllerGithubId; add ControlPayload members identity, command, controller-send, command-ack; update the header and ControlPayload doc comments. The file stays type-only with no import. Because frameOf in src/dashboard/server/services/share-host.ts (lines 132-147) switches exhaustively over ShareCommand, add its `case 'set-controller': return { type: 'set-controller', githubId: command.githubId };` in the same commit so typecheck stays green; that is the only share-host.ts change in this item.

items.title: Given the edited contracts, when `npm run typecheck` runs, then it exits 0 and packages/contracts/src/sharing.ts contains no line starting with `import`.
ShareCommand accepts `{ type: 'set-controller', githubId }` and SharedControllerCommand rejects `{ type: 'unrevoke', githubId }` at the type level.
ControlPayload contains the kinds identity, command, controller-send and command-ack with the fields listed in the PRD, and ShareView contains an optional numeric controllerGithubId.
Create the pure controller module: appointment state, gate and command decoder

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/server/sharing/controller.ts and src/dashboard/server/sharing/__tests__/controller.test.ts per PRD section 'Controller module': ControllerState (current/appoint/onSnapshot, effective controller = appointed only when snapshot.controllerGithubId equals it, else the data owner), controlRefusal with the eight ordered rules (reclaim always allowed; not_controller; viewer unrevoke invalid_command; viewer self target invalid_target; set-controller target must be owner or admitted+host-admitted; owner actor otherwise allowed; viewer targets lobby/listed/admitted), and readControllerCommand rebuilding a command from known keys only and refusing unrevoke. No I/O, no timers.

items.title: Given a snapshot whose controllerGithubId is 100 and no appointment, when ControllerState.current runs, then it returns the data owner's id; after appoint(100) it returns 100.
Given a viewer controls, when controlRefusal runs for the owner actor with set-controller naming the owner, then it returns null, and for the owner actor with kick it returns 'not_controller'.

controlRefusal returns 'invalid_command' for a viewer unrevoke, 'invalid_target' for a viewer targeting itself, and 'unknown_participant' for set-controller naming a lobby participant or one isHostAdmitted rejects.
readControllerCommand returns null for unrevoke, a non-integer githubId or a non-boolean contributor, and never copies an unknown key into its result.
Enforce the controller in PeerHub and accept viewer-controller commands over control

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only peer-hub.ts and its test; no other ready item edits those files, and its blockers (wire-types, controller-gate) are its only inputs.

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/server/sharing/peer-hub.ts and append describe('PeerHub controller handoff (PAN-4478)') to src/dashboard/server/sharing/__tests__/peer-hub.test.ts per PRD section 'Peer hub': own a ControllerState; implement the new HostHub methods controllerGithubId/isHostAdmitted/appoint (appoint refreshes presence only when the new appointment is the data owner); call controller.onSnapshot in onSnapshot before reconcile; pass the effective controller into presenceOf (new optional fifth parameter); send control identity { githubId } right after a hello negotiates; dispatch control 'command' to onCommand and 'controller-send' to onControllerSend with the PRD's step lists; extract eligibleParticipant from onSubmit; answer command-ack. Update the controlPayloads helper (line 771) to drop identity payloads. Run the loopback and integration peer-hub tests too and filter identity there if they assert exact control payload lists. Keep peer-hub.ts under 1000 lines.

items.title: Given B (100) is appointed and the snapshot confirms it, when B sends control command admit 200, then ctx.sendFrame receives exactly { type: 'admit', githubId: 200 }, B gets command-ack accepted, and a peer for 200 starts once a snapshot shows 200 admitted and connected.

Given the data owner reclaims with appoint(1), when B then sends command kick 200, then B gets command-ack rejected not_controller and no frame is sent, and B's presence shows controllerGithubId 1 before any new snapshot.
Given a snapshot names 100 as controller without a host appointment, when 100 sends any command, then the hub rejects it not_controller and presence shows the data owner's id.
After a peer's hello negotiates, the hub sends control identity with that peer's githubId before the first presence envelope.
Given B is the effective controller, when B sends controller-send with text 'Go', then the prompt is queued credited to B's login and B gets command-ack accepted with position 1.
Gate the data owner's share commands and prompts on the controller and accept set-controller on the route

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/server/services/share-host.ts, src/dashboard/server/routes/shares.ts, src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/share-host.test.ts and tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/shares.test.ts per PRD section 'Share manager and route': ShareManager.command calls controlRefusal with the owner actor (controller from host.hub.controllerGithubId(), falling back to snapshot.controllerGithubId; isHostAdmitted from the hub, falling back to true) and answers 409 { error, message } on refusal; mirror set-controller to hub.appoint after the frame is sent; sendPrompt answers 409 not_controller while a viewer controls; viewOf adds controllerGithubId without spreading undefined; add REFUSAL_MESSAGES; update header comments. routes/shares.ts: COMMAND_TYPES and parseShareCommand accept set-controller; route table comment lists the new 409s. Update FakeHub (share-host.test.ts line 388) and stubHub (shares.test.ts line 248) with the three new HostHub methods. End share stays ungated.

items.title: Given the hub reports a viewer (100) as controller, when the owner calls ShareManager.command with kick or ShareManager.sendPrompt, then each returns status 409 with error 'not_controller' and no frame is sent on the host socket.

Given a viewer controls, when the owner calls ShareManager.command with { type: 'set-controller', githubId: <owner id> }, then it returns 202, the host socket receives that frame, and hub.appoint is called with the owner's id.
Given the hub has not host-admitted 300, when the owner hands control to 300, then the manager returns 409 'unknown_participant' and sends nothing.
parseShareCommand returns { type: 'set-controller', githubId: 7 } for that body and null when githubId is missing, and GET /api/shares views carry the hub's controllerGithubId.
Read identity and command acks and send controller commands in the viewer's WebRTC peer

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/webrtc-viewer.ts and __tests__/webrtc-viewer.test.ts per PRD section 'Browser peer': callbacks onIdentity and onCommandAck; exported CommandAck and readCommandAck (known keys, COMMAND_REFUSALS set of the eight reasons); onControl handles identity (positive safe integer githubId) and command-ack; new methods command(clientId, command) and controllerSend(clientId, text, draftGithubId?) that use sendOn('control', ...). Update the header comment.

items.title: Given the host sends control identity { githubId: 100 }, when the viewer reads it, then onIdentity is called with 100; a non-integer githubId calls nothing.
Given the host sends command-ack with an unknown reason, when the viewer reads it, then onCommandAck receives the ack without a reason field.
After the hello reply, command() and controllerSend() each send one control envelope with the next seq (2, then 3) and the method returns true; before the hello reply the method returns false.
Expose controller state, sendCommand and sendControllerPrompt with ack timeouts in useSharedJoin

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/useSharedJoin.ts and __tests__/useSharedJoin.test.tsx per PRD section 'Join hook': selfGithubId from onIdentity (cleared in resetContent); isController = selfGithubId !== null && presence.controllerGithubId === selfGithubId; COMMAND_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000; pending ack map with timers; sendCommand and sendControllerPrompt promises; failPending('Connection to the host was lost.') on resetContent and closeViewer; exported commandRefusalText with the PRD's messages; extend ViewerPeer Pick and SharedJoin. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers and vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync, never real waits.

items.title: Given identity 100 and presence controllerGithubId 100, when the hook renders, then isController is true; with presence controllerGithubId 1 it is false.
Given a sent command, when the host acks accepted, then sendCommand resolves; when it acks rejected not_controller, then sendCommand rejects with 'You no longer have control.'
Given a sent command and no ack, when 10,000 ms of fake time pass, then sendCommand rejects with 'The host did not answer.'
Given a pending command, when reconnect() runs, then the command rejects with 'Connection to the host was lost.'
Split SharingLobbyPanel into LobbyRoster and add Hand control and Reclaim control

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/SharingLobbyPanel.tsx and __tests__/SharingLobbyPanel.test.tsx per PRD section 'Lobby panel': export LobbyPerson and LobbyRoster (props people, blocked or null, controllerGithubId, selfGithubId, canAct, disabled, onCommand); add a Hand control button (aria-label 'Hand control to @<login>', command set-controller) on admitted rows except selfGithubId; no buttons on selfGithubId rows; offline marker only when connected === false. Keep SharingLobbyPanel({ share, onCommand, pending }) as the host wrapper: controller = share.controllerGithubId ?? snapshot.controllerGithubId; when a viewer controls, render '@<login> has control.' and a Reclaim control button and pass canAct false. Follow the pan-style-guide skill.

items.title: Given the data owner controls, when the panel renders, then each admitted row has a 'Hand control to @<login>' button and clicking it calls onCommand with { type: 'set-controller', githubId }.

Given share.controllerGithubId is bob's id, when the panel renders, then it shows '@bob has control.' and a 'Reclaim control' button that sends set-controller with the owner's id, and renders no Admit, Kick, Revoke or Un-revoke button.

Show suggestions read-only in the share dialog while a viewer controls

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/ShareDialog.tsx and __tests__/ShareDialog.test.tsx per PRD section 'Share dialog': compute ownerControls from share.controllerGithubId ?? share.snapshot.controllerGithubId against share.snapshot.dataOwner.githubId (true when either is missing); SuggestionList mode is 'controller' only when ownerControls; PROMPT_ERRORS adds not_controller 'Someone else has control. Reclaim control first.'; update the header comment.

items.title: Given a share whose controllerGithubId is a viewer's id and one draft, when the dialog renders, then the suggestion row shows no 'Use suggestion from @<login>' button.

Render the You have control panel, controller composer and control marker on the viewer page

narrative.Action: Edit src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/SharedConversationView.tsx and __tests__/SharedConversationView.test.tsx per PRD section 'Viewer page': in-file SharedControllerPanel (data-component 'shared-controller', heading 'You have control', 'Hand control back to @<owner>' button, LobbyRoster from presence participants minus the host with blocked null, error alert from rejected commands) rendered between the timeline and the composer only when isController; SharedComposer for the controller uses sendControllerPrompt for Send prompt and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, clears the box on success, and switches SuggestionList to controller mode with onSend calling sendControllerPrompt(text, item.githubId); Header shows '@<login> has control' when presence's controller is not the host. items.title: Given isController is false, when the page renders an admitted viewer, then no [data-component="shared-controller"] element exists; given isController is true it exists with 'You have control'.

Given the controller panel lists carol in the lobby, when the viewer clicks 'Admit @carol' (exact), then sendCommand is called with { type: 'admit', githubId: <carol id> }; 'Hand control back to @owner' calls sendCommand with set-controller and the host's id.

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/frontend/tests/pan-4478-controller-handoff.spec.ts per PRD section 'End-to-end test', copying the harness of tests/pan-4476-shared-input.spec.ts (Miniflare share Worker, ACCOUNT_STUB with owner 1, alice 100 and bob 200, three startIsolatedDashboard children, dead-loopback account.json and directory_url, local avatar PNG, never port 3011).
